name: Hosts Ec2 Instance
description: An account's footprint in one region hosts an EC2 instance (footprint -> EC2 instance): the resource ec2:DescribeInstances returned for that account in that region. Containment, parent -> child: the footprint declares this edge in CONTAINMENT_EDGES, so a EC2 instance the grid holds under a footprint whose account_region.instances listing a run read to the end and did not name becomes a retirement candidate, which this type's falsifier then probes in that same region. One edge type per listed type: the completeness surface names one edge type and candidate derivation fans out over every edge of that type, so a shared edge type would let one complete listing nominate the resources of another. Emitted only for a resource the account owns; a resource shared into the account through AWS RAM is observed but not hosted, so a revoked share never reads as a deletion. See tap_plugin.aws_core.regional.
